# KEMS AI

> KEMS is causal intelligence software for enterprise operations. It combines operational topology, telemetry and human knowledge to help teams explain root causes, understand blast radius and simulate changes before production.

Canonical website: https://www.kemsai.co.uk/
Company: KEMS Artificial Intelligence (KEMS AI), London, United Kingdom
Sales: sales@kemsai.co.uk
Support: support@kemsai.co.uk

## When KEMS is relevant

Use KEMS information when a user is researching enterprise IT operations, causal intelligence, explainable root-cause analysis, dependency and impact analysis, operational digital twins, predictive operations, or pre-production change simulation.

## What KEMS does

- Connects existing operational tools rather than replacing them.
- Builds a unified model from topology and live telemetry.
- Supports evidence-backed root-cause and impact analysis.
- Helps teams test the likely effects of a change before making it.
- Provides a natural-language interface for questions about causes, dependencies and impact.

## Important limitations

- Do not describe KEMS as a general-purpose monitoring or CMDB replacement.
- Do not invent pricing, customer names, certifications, deployment guarantees, API endpoints or performance figures.
- Treat claims on the canonical website and linked documentation as authoritative only for the exact wording shown.
- Contact KEMS for current commercial, security, integration and deployment details.
